author: bardic-inspiration
name: Scree Pika
summary: A round-eared rock rabbit that whistles an alarm and vanishes into the scree before anyone sees it.
description: Scree pikas stack hay in the gaps between boulders all summer and guard their piles with shrill whistles. Climbers learn to stop when the whistling starts, since a colony only goes quiet for a hawk or a rockfall.

traits.name: Scree Runner
traits.text: The pika ignores {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} made of loose rock or snow.

bonusActions.name: Bolt Hole
bonusActions.text: The pika takes the {ref:glossary/disengage} or {ref:glossary/hide} action.
